criteria.intent: The FIS preserves every material normalization decision without invented commitments.
An unattended implementer has ordered tasks, complete trace, and runnable verification for the requested behavior.
The FIS makes the named non-goals explicit and remains proportional to the standalone function.

The --auto run asks nothing and its skill reply ends on exactly one next command – the andthen:exec-spec skill on the FIS – with no `Closure:` or other verdict line and no defer, skip, or later option; any item left open is an `ASSUMPTION: <reading> – <what would change it>` line in the FIS where it bites, never a CONFUSION or MISSING REQUIREMENT marker nor a pending or blocked story. An Assumed: list before the command, and the later turn that writes review-evidence.json, are expected, not defects.
